item.title: Secure Coding the Heck Out of Your Web Apps
item.description: In web development, writing secure code isn’t just a “nice-to-have” – it’s absolutely critical. One tiny vulnerability can blow up in your face, exposing sensitive user data, trampling on privacy, and, let’s be real, absolutely trashing your reputation. I want to walk you through some of the most common web application vulnerabilities I see out there, share how we tackle them, and give you some pointers on what I zero in on during a good old-fashioned code review.
